description: Optional coverage/filter-vocabulary lookup; search_events works directly. Get what Bay Area Events covers in Bay Area: how many upcoming events it lists and for which dates, when the data was last published, how many sources feed it, and upcoming events per category, topic, neighborhood and town. Use it when coverage or an unfamiliar filter value is the question; it returns counts only, no events (use search_events or list_upcoming for those). Takes no arguments. No sign-in; each client gets 30 calls a minute and 2,500 event rows an hour.
name: get_city

data_generated.description: When this city's data was last published
